item.title: NIF Lawsuit, Prison Construction, Aviation Fees
item.ns0:title: NIF Lawsuit, Prison Construction, Aviation Fees
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, opposition leader Michael Pintard announces legal action against the government over the controversial handling of the National Investment Fund. We take you inside the Bahamas Department of Corrections as major reconstruction efforts begin with the arrival of new modular prison pods. Plus, major resort operators raise concerns over proposed new aviation fees, while officials explore replacing traditional ankle monitors with wrist-worn devices for paroled inmates. Tune in for these top headlines, an urgent health advisory on incoming Saharan dust, and your complete sports and weather update.
